description.description: One or two sentences restating the deal

percent.description: Share of the total released when this milestone is approved

id.description: Short id, unique inside the milestone, e.g. "c1"

text.description: One objectively checkable condition, e.g. "50 t-shirts are visible or counted"

evidenceTypes.description: Evidence the seller may submit for this milestone

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or null to use the contract deadline

email.description: PayPal email that receives the payout

windowHours.description: Hours after a verdict during which either party may dispute
